capture_submission fixture

Each button issues a request and writes the outcome into #status. When capture_submission is armed, WRITES are intercepted+aborted → outcome neterror (neutralized, never sent); READS pass through → outcome sent status=NNN. The local static server returns 404 (GET) / 501 (POST) for these paths — so a "sent" outcome means the request really left the page (no side effect on localhost), which is exactly what capture must PREVENT for writes.

status: (idle)
